summary: United Bankshares filed an 8-K announcing a third-quarter dividend of $0.38 per share and a new share repurchase plan (2026 Plan) authorizing up to 6.8 million shares (~5% of outstanding). The plan replaces the November 2025 plan, terminated immediately. Repurchases may occur via open market or private negotiations; management retains discretion on timing and quantity. No board recommendation, advisors, or fixed terms beyond the authorization. The filing is a routine capital return event, not a special situation requiring event-driven analysis.
